tools.name: get_supplier_profile
tools.description: Returns Onan Capital Inc credentials: SDVOSB, CAGE 827Y8, UEI G8NFS5UCJ9F7, NAICS 423450, TIPS Contract 260804 Vendor 13662 through October 31, 2029, warehouses, payment terms, and contacts. Does not return prices or a street address.

tools.name: check_cooperative_eligibility
tools.description: Confirms whether a named cooperative contract matches Onan Capital's TIPS Contract 260804 award. Does not claim Sourcewell, OMNIA, Equalis, E&I, BuyBoard, or NASPO. Does not return a price.

tools.name: search_supplies
tools.description: Searches Onan's live catalog and the manufacturer numbers buyers already use (Halyard 55082, PDI P86984, Clorox Healthcare 35309, Purell 9652-12, 3M 8210, and the rest of the equivalents list). Returns Onan SKUs with no prices. A manufacturer number is not an Onan SKU.

tools.name: get_catalog_summary
tools.description: Lists institutional PPE categories and the RFQ process. For a real SKU or a brand number, use search_supplies. Never returns a price or a live quantity on hand.

tools.name: submit_rfq
tools.description: Sends a structured quote request to Onan Capital. Required: organization, name, email, and lines (description and quantity, plus unit of measure when known). Returns a reference id. A person writes the quote. Do not send unit prices.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_supplier_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
